705480101.text: Oh my, it looks like Hertha has gone back to her duties, and Glenfidia is away somewhere too... Has our dear cutie taken complete charge of the drinks stand?

705480104.text: Wonderful. Now I can order without worrying about ending up with one of the Logistics Company "specials" — the type of drink that keeps you awake all night, leaving you no choice but to pass the time working...

705480301.text: Finished! A new creation, custom-made for you...

705480302.text: This should help you fall asleep quickly and guarantee you peaceful dreams. It's called a "Slumbering Rose."

705480303.text: From the colors to the choice of glass, everything's been carefully crafted. You've turned it into a completely different drink...

705480304.text: Based purely on appearance, it's exactly my style! Time to see how it tastes...

705480306.text: It's like... savoring an exquisite dessert before taking a stroll along the shore of Cider Lake, with the gentle breeze caressing your skin, relaxed and at ease...

705480307.text: I no longer feel drained of energy, but neither am I overstimulated!

705480308.text: *yawn* I'm actually starting to feel a little sleepy... As a bedtime drink, this is pure perfection...

705480309.text: So good, in fact, that I feel like writing an article to extol the virtues of this "Slumbering Rose." I can use it as an opportunity to crown you the "New Maestro of Mixology."

705480312.text: Speaking of lakeside strolls, why don't you join me next time there's a clear, warm day when the sun is bright but not too harsh?

705480313.text: Any walk would be more relaxing with you to talk to along the way, cutie...

705480314.text: Then, when we get back, you could fix me up another glass of Slumbering Rose!

705480201.text: Here's a Snow-Kissed Dawn. Hope you like it!

705480203.text: Pleasantly tart, sweet but not cloying, smooth on the palate, with a refreshing aftertaste.

705480204.text: If anything, though, I seem to be feeling a little more energetic than I'd like...

705480205.text: Perhaps you've unwittingly unraveled Glenfidia's secret and concocted an even more effective pick-me-up?

705480208.text: Don't worry, there's no rush! Hmm... Your eyes are aglow with curiosity, as though you have many more questions to ask...

705480209.text: Let's chat for a while. Take your time... inspiration will come soon enough.

705480210.text: Which books have you collected today?

705480211.text: *sigh* Since you're asking, it's been a bit of an unusual day.

705480212.text: There's a chef, fresh out of training in Fontaine, who's recently taken up a position at the Goth Grand Hotel. She borrowed our most valuable book, "The Mondstadt Millennial Compendium of Desserts."

705480213.text: Apparently, she plans to use dessert-making techniques to improve the taste of various savory dishes. Something about reducing their greasiness...
